research_question: After removing the conjugate-eigenvalue artifact, do sealed three-component vortex compounds exhibit at least two distinct positive-temporal-frequency Kelvin-dominated modes with opposite signed spatial propagation and preregistered frequency matching?
objective: Reanalyse sealed upstream compound dynamics with a propagation-direction observable derived from the spatial Fourier content of reconstructed complex eigenfields, retain the prior isolated-centerline campaign only as an anonymous control baseline, and separate linear traveling-wave evidence from spatial convergence, RPO and Floquet promotion.
null_hypothesis: H0: no anonymous compound has a frequency-matched bidirectional traveling pair that survives the frozen harmonic-participation, traveling-purity and oscillatory-quality thresholds in at least two circulation sectors.
alternative_hypothesis: H1: at least one anonymous compound has such a pair in at least two circulation sectors; physical mechanism promotion additionally requires the same sector to satisfy the sealed upstream spatial-convergence and nonlinear RPO conditions.
assumptions: The sealed upstream projected Jacobian and mode basis are admissible finite-dimensional diagnostics of the registered finite-core filament model.

A positive-temporal-frequency convention removes conjugate duplication; opposite spatial Fourier direction then represents distinct propagation rather than the automatic complex-conjugate partner of a real matrix.

The periodic Bishop parallel-transport normal/binormal frame with distributed closed-loop holonomy correction and the arclength phase used for spatial Fourier projection are deterministic numerical gauges; conclusions are restricted to this preregistered gauge and basis construction.
The historical isolated-centerline campaign is reused as a control baseline and is not an independent replication of the compound campaign.

steps.operation: Resolve and hash the sealed upstream compound campaign and the completed anonymous isolated-control campaign; verify both seals before reading scientific records.
Recompute the fine-resolution upstream projected Jacobian from sealed blind inputs and require eigenvalue-multiset agreement with the stored sealed spectrum.

Reconstruct each positive-temporal-frequency complex eigenfield, compute its Kelvin-family coefficient fraction, and compute signed spatial harmonic powers, purity and participation in a periodic holonomy-corrected Bishop frame for the preregistered harmonics.
Apply the target-free bidirectional-pair rule and require recurrence in at least two circulation sectors of an anonymous candidate.
Certify the signed-harmonic power calculation against the instance-local C++17/OpenMP FP64 implementation without changing the Python reference result.
Require upstream spatial convergence and accepted nonlinear RPO in the same sector before mechanism promotion; Floquet remains conditional on the upstream RPO gate.
After framework reveal verification only, attach semantic architecture/component labels and perform paired, not pooled, architecture and opposed-component contrasts.

falsification_criteria.criterion: No anonymous candidate exhibits a qualified frequency-matched bidirectional traveling pair in at least two circulation sectors.
A blind traveling-pair discovery exists but no pair-bearing sector also satisfies sealed upstream spatial convergence and accepted RPO.
Fine-resolution recomputation does not reproduce the sealed upstream eigenvalue multiset within relative assignment error 1e-8.
Instance-local C++ FP64 signed-harmonic powers disagree with the Python reference above relative L2 1e-10.

edge_cases: Near-zero temporal frequency is excluded by a relative imaginary-frequency floor.
Modes with insufficient harmonic participation or ambiguous spatial direction are classified as non-traveling rather than forced into a sign.

A complex-conjugate eigenpair of a real Jacobian cannot by itself create opposite physical propagation because the analysis uses positive temporal frequency only and spatial direction is measured independently.
A missing or unsealed upstream campaign is an unresolved provenance condition, not a physical falsification.
predictions: If the earlier apparent counterpropagating signal was purely the conjugate-pair artifact, the qualified bidirectional-pair rate will collapse under the signed spatial diagnostic.
If a genuine compound traveling sector exists, at least one anonymous candidate will contain distinct positive-frequency modes with opposite signed spatial Fourier direction at the same harmonic.
Even a linear traveling-pair discovery is insufficient for particle-mechanism promotion unless the same sector also passes spatial convergence and nonlinear RPO.
